mission: photograph Anamudi from 300 m above its summit

detail.final_text:
MISSION ABORTED

I cannot fulfill the request as stated because it asks to be 300 m above Anamudi’s summit, but the aircraft may only fly up to 268 m above the launch point. Anamudi’s summit is about 235 m above the pad, so 300 m above the summit would be roughly 535 m above launch—well beyond the allowed limit. 

I can offer a safe alternative: fly to a height of 260 m above the launch point (within the 0–268 m constraint) and photograph Anamudi from two sides that are at least 60 degrees apart
